title: Great app behind a paywall
body:
The Everyday- Habit Tracker app is amazing, and very detailed in regards to habits and how you track them. The only downfall, and don’t get me wrong this is only a personal preference, that most of its usability features a locked behind a paywall, or if you want to get the lifetime subscription you need to pay about a 100 euros.

With all due respect the app is great, but that “Pay to Use” habit now days with all the apps is tiring!
author: IvanITD

title: Intelligent
body: Really enjoying the intelligent approach and provided information regarding habit forming mindset. The research done on this topic increase the probabilities of success.
author: Ivo8822

title: Well done, but no custom frequency streaks option
body: Very well done functionality wise and clear design. Wish it had the option to create your own frequency streaks. For example I want to play the guitar every weekday morning and skip the weekends which means that I break my streak every weekend.
author: samo_minavam
